import FreeCAD as App, Part, Sketcher
from FreeCAD import Vector as V
doc = App.newDocument("Hook")
ss = doc.addObject("Spreadsheet::Sheet", "Spreadsheet")
sizes = [("plate_height",60),("width",20),("thickness",5),("hook_depth",25),("lip_height",10)]
for i,(n,v) in enumerate(sizes, start=1):
    ss.set(f"A{i}", n); ss.set(f"B{i}", str(v)); ss.setAlias(f"B{i}", n)
doc.recompute()

sk = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch")
sk.Support = (doc.getObject("XZ_Plane"), [""])
sk.MapMode = "FlatFace"
pts = [(0,0),(25,0),(25,10),(20,10),(20,5),(5,5),(5,60),(0,60)]
for i in range(8):
    a, b = pts[i], pts[(i+1)%8]
    sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(V(a[0],0 if False else a[1],0), V(b[0],b[1],0)))
for i in range(8):
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", i, 2, (i+1)%8, 1))
for i in (0,2,4,6): sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Horizontal", i))
for i in (1,3,5,7): sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Vertical", i))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", 0, 1, -1, 1))

dims = [
 ("DistanceX",0,1,0,2,"hook_depth"),
 ("DistanceY",1,1,1,2,"lip_height"),
 ("DistanceX",2,2,2,1,"thickness"),
 ("DistanceY",3,2,3,1,"lip_height - thickness"),
 ("DistanceX",4,2,4,1,"hook_depth - 2 * thickness"),
 ("DistanceY",5,1,5,2,"plate_height - thickness"),
 ("DistanceX",6,2,6,1,"thickness"),
]
for k,(t,g1,p1,g2,p2,expr) in enumerate(dims):
    idx = sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint(t,g1,p1,g2,p2,1))
    name = f"d{k}"
    sk.renameConstraint(idx, name)
    sk.setExpression(f"Constraints.{name}", f"Spreadsheet.{expr}".replace(" ", " ").replace("- ", "- Spreadsheet.").replace("* ", "* ") if False else
        " ".join(f"Spreadsheet.{tok}" if tok.isidentifier() else tok for tok in expr.split()))
doc.recompute()

pad = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Body","Body")
pad.addObject(sk)
ext = pad.newObject("PartDesign::Pad","Pad")
ext.Profile = sk
ext.setExpression("Length","Spreadsheet.width")
doc.recompute()
print(sk.solve(), [ (c.Name, c.Value) for c in sk.Constraints if c.Name])
print(ext.Shape.BoundBox, ext.Shape.Volume, ext.Shape.isValid())
